guide: Open Start and type your practice name and your rules in the yellow cells: days to finish a note (2 is the default), supervision ratio, continuing education hours a year, renewal alert days and months between consent reviews.
Check Team first. The associate (works under supervision) is flagged there, and each member has a phone number for the ready messages.
Log every session on Note Status and fill the note-done date when the note is finished. Overdue notes are counted by clinician and the team table ranks who to call first.
Record treatment-plan reviews on Plan Reviews and outcome scores on Outcome Scores. Score Change by Client compares the intake score with the latest score.
Record each discharge on Discharges with its closing letter and referral letter. Records Keep-until shows the archive date and the keep-until date from the years you enter.
Log supervision on Supervision Log and the monthly sessions on Supervision by Month. The hours owed are client sessions divided by your ratio.
Log courses on Continuing Education Log. Only hours with a certificate count towards the yearly target; check your own local rules.
Keep the Renewal Register current: insurance, licences and certificates. Amber and red alerts and the act-first rank show what to renew first.

Use Consent Records, Record Requests, Privacy Checks, Policy Reviews and the Incident and Complaint Log for the rest of your admin duties. The workbook holds dates and status only, never case content.
Use the 18 decision tools: each ends with a verdict and a what-if table. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready messages.
Read the Clinical Admin KPI Dashboard and Charts every week: notes on time, overdue reviews, supervision hours, continuing education and renewals.

listing.title: Therapy Practice Clinical Admin Excel Template: Session Notes, Supervision Hours, CE Tracker, Renewal Register, KPI Dashboard
listing.headline: Keep notes, supervision, CE and renewals on track in one Excel file
listing.description:
Run the clinical admin of a small group practice in one Excel workbook. Built for talking therapists and counsellors: an owner-clinician, employed clinicians, contract (self-employed) clinicians, an associate who works under supervision and a practice coordinator.

Note Status checks every session note against your rule (2 days by default) and ranks which clinician to call first about overdue notes. Plan Reviews tracks treatment-plan reviews with days overdue, and Score Change by Client compares each intake outcome score with the latest to show who improved. Discharges, Records Keep-until, Consent Records, Record Requests, Privacy Checks, Policy Reviews and the Incident and Complaint Log cover the rest of the duty of care in admin terms. Supervision Log and Supervision by Month work out the hours owed to an associate from your sessions-per-hour ratio, with cost. CE Log and CE by Year count only certified hours against your yearly target. The Renewal Register ranks insurance, licences and certificates with amber and red alerts and a twelve-month cost planner.

18 decision tools answer weekly questions with a verdict and a what-if table: overdue notes catch-up, review backlog planner, supervision hours owed, continuing education pace and budget, renewal alert and cost, records keep-until date and more. Print 12 sheets and 12 letters and reports, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages.

This is part six of the Therapy Private Practice suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, one flat price with no per-clinician fee, your data stays with you, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data. The workbook holds dates and status only, never session notes or diagnoses, and it does not promise results.
